name: Sports bra
description: A snug stretch bra with a firm elastic band and a racer back, made to hold still through a run or a fight.
notes: Laid flat, 260 mm across and 250 mm from the band to the strap junction: a thin black elastic underband and centre gore, a smooth grey body curving in to the underarms with two moulded cups, a scoop neck bound in black and wide straps meeting in a black racer-back tab. `cloth-heather-grey` with `lycra-black`. Slot `bra`, as the bikini tops take. The XL size rides on this model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Tank top

notes: Folded on a shelf, neck at +z, 240 mm by 280 mm and 24 mm tall: heather-grey cotton with a ribbed scoop neck and armholes cut into the shoulders, painted dark where the openings are. Slot `undershirt` is new: it is the base layer under a shirt, as `bra` sits under one, so a shirt or jacket can still go over it in `torso`. A tank top worn on its own also sits in that slot. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.
